name: 麦位说话声波
gameplayMeaning: 该成员正在通过获准的麦克风发声
trigger: 200ms getVolumeLevel sampling of the authorized local published track or subscribed remote track; level > 0.06, held 700ms

implementation.cleanupRule: Remove badge on mute, unpublish, lost membership, disconnect, silence or unmount; remove SDK listeners and clear silence watchdog on disconnect.
implementation.platform: DOM/CSS badge at the seat portrait bottom-right; transform-only scaleY bars; no Cocos assets or scene mutation

variants.full: Three small vertical waveform bars scale inside a 20px badge, no flashing
variants.low: Same small DOM badge, no particles or textures
variants.colorIndependentCue: Waveform silhouette and accessible speaking label

validation.worstCase: 32 authorized speakers, 96 tiny transform-only bars; minimum physical device performance remains unverified
